bug_info.bug_desc: In the old code, host_scramble_en and host_ecc_en are derived only from region_cfg.scramble_en and region_cfg.ecc_en using a loose mubi true test. The region configuration's enable bit (region_cfg.en) is ignored. As a result, a host read targeting a disabled or non-matching memory-protection region can still have scrambling/ECC applied if the region's scramble_en/ecc_en bits are set. This violates the specification, which requires that a host read with no matching region, or with a matching region that is not enabled, be treated as non-scrambled and non-ECC. The observable failure is that host direct reads can use different attributes than controller accesses or than the intended memory-protection region configuration.
bug_info.fix_hint: Include the region enable bit when computing the host read attributes. Combine region_cfg.en with region_cfg.scramble_en and region_cfg.ecc_en using a mubi AND operation, then test the resulting mubi value with the strict true test. This ensures disabled regions are treated as non-scrambled and non-ECC.
